messages:
Samira Patel: Quick announcement — please welcome Mariam Okoye, who joins Redwood next Monday (2026-04-06) as Director, Private Deployments (on‑prem & VPC). She'll lead the Private team and own our on‑prem product roadmap, compliance integrations, and partner ops. :tada:
Mariam Okoye: Hi everyone! Excited to join Redwood — looking forward to meeting y'all and getting into the on‑prem playbook. Happy to sync 1:1s next week.
Ben Liu: Huge welcome! Mariam will be taking ownership from me on Private. I'll be shifting fully to lead Dedicated Capacity while we hire a backfill for my infra manager role.
Priya Natarajan: Welcome Mariam — great to have you. We'll align on runtime compatibility & quantization requirements early next week.
Jordan Kim: Congrats Mariam. Quick Q — does this org change affect the Dedicated vs Private headcount buckets for Q2 hiring?
Samira Patel: @Jordan short answer: Dedicated headcount stays as planned. We're moving 1 FTE from Eng-Infra to Private (Mariam's role is net-new Director). Ben's infra-manager slot will be posted as a backfill (IC manager) — hiring reqs to follow.
Lizzy Mendoza: Onboarding plan + links below. Mariam — assigned onboarding buddy: @Aaron Cho. New hire checklist created in Workday and Onboard tool.
Lizzy Mendoza: ```
Onboarding — Mariam Okoye (Director, Private Deployments)
- Mon 04/06: HR + device provisioning, security training
- Tue 04/07: Private product overview (Ben + Priya)
- Wed 04/08: Infra tour + infra ownership handoff (Ben)
- Week 1: 1:1s with Platform, Runtime, Sales Eng, Security
- Week 2: Stakeholder interviews + roadmap workshop
```
Aaron Cho: Welcome Mariam — I'm your buddy. I'll DM to set up the Week 1 1:1s and share runbooks.
OnboardBot: New-hire profile created for Mariam Okoye. Orientation calendar invites sent to platform leads.
Diego Morales: Welcome aboard, Mariam :wave: Looking forward to your thoughts on compliance flows.
Evan Carter: Congrats! If you want any context on partner integrations we've done in APAC, happy to share.
Ben Liu: Action items — Samira to publish hiring req for infra manager by EOD Fri; Lizzy to confirm device procurement; Mariam to accept calendar invites.
Samira Patel: Noted. I'll post the req in #recruiting and link the JD here: https://corpus.internal/recruiting/infra-manager-jd
Mariam Okoye: Thanks all — accepted invites. Looking forward to the handoff and meeting everyone.
Priya Natarajan: Welcome again. We'll schedule a 30m sync after your first week to identify any runtime blockers.
Lizzy Mendoza: FYI — people-ops will run a short intro in All-Hands next Tuesday to announce org update. Please react with :thumbsup: when you see the draft post in #announcements.
Diego Morales: :thumbsup:
Evan Carter: :thumbsup:
